Navigate the Ocean of Wisdom — Sacred Texts

The library of Sanatan Dharma is vast, categorized fundamentally into two branches: Shruti (revelation) and Smriti (tradition). Unlike Western religions centered around a single historical book, the Dharmic tradition relies on an interconnected ecosystem of texts mapping out philosophy, ritual, psychology, and devotion.

From the rigorous metaphysical inquiry of the Upanishads to the battlefield pragmatism of the Bhagavad Gita, each text serves a different spiritual temperament. Explore the foundational scriptures below to find the entry point that resonates with your path.
